messages:
Asha (CEO): Quick leadership update for the week — thanks team. High-level bullets:
- Hosted API: soft-launch next Tue 3/31. Marketing will run the beta cohort; expect limited GA invites first week.
- Dedicated: closed a second annual commit with Procyon (woot) — adds ~10% predictable revenue.
- Private: FinReg pilot starting next month; compliance checklist live in Console (see link in docs).
Metrics snapshot: ARR +18% QoQ; p50 latency (hosted) 85ms (-8% w/w); infra cost per 1M tokens -6% after batching tweaks.
Top priorities: finalize EU region rollout schedule, enforce deploy freeze after Thu rollout window, prep sales/renewal collateral.
Ask: VPs — one-line status in this thread by EOD. Anything blocking? :rocket:

Diego (VP Product): Noted. Will post roadmap updates by EOD. EU rollout target: canary 4/6, will confirm by tomorrow.

Maya (VP Eng): Infra update: autoscaler bug fixed in staging, p50 improved. Working on a small kernel tweak that should drop tail latency. I'll open an RFC for deploy-freeze exceptions. Scheduling a dry run 3/30 14:00 PT.

Liam (VP Sales): Love the Procyon news — will use it for renewals. Updating the renewal playbook and circling back on upsell motions from Dedicated commits. Need a one-pager / case study soon.

Juno (Head of Ops): Compliance ops: building runbook for FinReg pilot, will attach checklist and evidence gallery. Calendar invite for dry run sent to eng-oncall + infra. @Asha — any specific reporting cadence you want during pilot?

Eliza (People Ops): Hiring update: approved for 4 SDE hires this quarter (infra + runtime). Updating interview rubrics for infra-focused roles and scheduling debrief training next week.

deploy-bot: Prod deploy scheduled Thu 21:00 PT. Notifying oncall and running preflight checks.

Diego (VP Product): Quick Q — can we add a one-slide comparison vs last quarter for latency and cost per token to the exec deck? Helpful for context in board updates.

Asha (CEO): Yes — Diego, include that 1-slide summary and the Procyon one-pager. Thanks all. Short exec sync Thu 9:00 AM PT to finalize launch communications. :thumbsup:
